interpretation_limits: The union is person-run sensor-witness coverage: ideal first-witness gate attribution plus separate legacy camera geometric association.
An ideal event proves one deterministic witness to a binary cell gate, not recognition of every co-located person.
Camera matches use confidence-ordered legacy cell-neighborhood geometry, not pixel visibility, box-IoU, or identity tracking.

Source timing differs: ideal availability is sensing tick N with truth snapshot N-1; camera availability is processing tick N+1 with truth snapshot N. The rendered capture is labelled tick N but contains human state through N-1.
Miss-penalized delay is descriptive, not an unbiased eventual detection-time estimate; seed intervals describe fixed-matrix seed blocks.
